### Summary

This section keeps the selector and the guards of the $r^2$-exact maps; the conversion weights, the pressure
operator and their derivation are in @sec-ch05-x1cent and are not repeated here.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects the spherical mean and pressure maps of @sec-ch05-x1cent.

**Data.** $r^2$-weighted primitives and face pressures in; plain means and pressure source out.

**Placement.** Before radial reconstruction and in the spherical pressure source.

**Activation.** `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT=1`, default off; implies WB.

**Guarantee / limits.** Degree-four mean conversion; unusable stencils retain the input means.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-centroid-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

Local symbols: $r=x_1$ is radius [m]; pressure is measured in Pa. The weighted mean uses the spherical volume
measure $r^2\,\mathrm{d}r$.

### Derivation

See @sec-ch05-x1cent for the moment solve and the integration by parts behind the pressure source. The
chapter's check line `[C3]` re-derives both independently: five $r^2$ moments of degree zero to four are
matched by the conversion, and the six-face pressure identity holds exactly for the quintic
[check `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

The switch is read once per process by `x1_centroid_exact_enabled`
({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_centroid_exact_enabled >}}), and `wb_ref4_enabled`
({{< code src/hydro/wb_ref4.cpp wb_ref4_enabled >}}) returns true whenever it does, so the fourth-order
reference and its guard (@sec-ch12-wb-reference) come with it, on any grid. The conversion itself acts only when
the coordinate type is `spherical-polar`: `HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}})
builds the stencils once per grid with `x1_plain_mean_stencils`
({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_plain_mean_stencils >}}) and reads the plain means with `x1_plain_means`
({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_plain_means >}}), with odd ghost corrections for the radial velocity at a
reflecting wall and the neighbour's converted rows past a seam; the pressure source uses
`x1_pressure_source_stencils` ({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_pressure_source_stencils >}}) and
`x1_pressure_source` ({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_pressure_source >}}), which need six faces. A
stencil that is not usable (too few cells, or too few owned cells next to a clamped wall) returns the original
means. `balance_column` ({{< code src/hydro/balance_column.cpp balance_column >}}) refuses any geometry but
`cartesian` while the switch is on, because it balances the declared Cartesian column.

```{python}

#| fig-alt: "five r-squared cell means; solve moments of degree 0..4; plain means for x1; six faces: pressure source."
```

### Code

**How to use it.** Set `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT=1` before launch. Merge this fragment into a complete spherical
card with suitable radial bounds and enough owned cells for the stencils:

<!-- reader glossary keys -->Keys in this fragment: `type`[^rg-edaa52092689].
```yaml
geometry:
  type: spherical-polar
  cells:
    nghost: 3
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8     # m s^-2
    gravity-work: cell
```

XC implies WB even if `SNAP_WB_REF4=0`; the same three-ghost refusal of @sec-ch12-wb-reference applies.
Do not use `balance_column` to construct this spherical state: with XC enabled it accepts only Cartesian geometry.
Unusable conversion stencils retain their input means rather than throwing.

`x1_centroid_exact_enabled` ({{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_centroid_exact_enabled >}}) contains this selection step:

```cpp
    auto v = get_env("SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT", "0");
    std::transform(v.begin(), v.end(), v.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char c) { return std::tolower(c); });
    return !(v.empty() || v == "0" || v == "false" || v == "off" || v == "no");
```

The default `"0"` leaves the maps off. A true result selects the degree-four mean conversion and the separate
six-face pressure identity of `[C3]`; the geometry gate remains in `HydroImpl::forward`.

: Implementation sites for the centroid selector. {#tbl-ch12-centroid-code}

1. Read the switch once; WB follows. The anchor `x1_centroid_exact_enabled` is in
   {{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_centroid_exact_enabled >}}.
2. On a spherical-polar grid, convert the $x_1$[^rg-84d62dd7c63a] inputs to plain means before the reconstruction. The anchor
   `wx1` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.
3. Use the six-face pressure operator for the radial source. The anchor `x1_pressure_source` is in
   {{< code src/coord/x1_centroid.cpp x1_pressure_source >}}.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_x1_centroid_rest_python` (CUDA variant registered) | force balance of a resting spherical column, implicit scheme 0 and 1, non-hydrostatic 1 and 0 | on below $10^{-10}$; off above $10^{-8}$ | `TOL_ON`, `TOL_OFF` |
| `test_x1_seam_split_x1_centroid.<b>` (CUDA and two-rank variants registered) | a split column matches one block | relative gap at most $10^{-13}$ | the test |
| `test_balance_column_x1_centroid.<b>`, `test_face_floor_x1_centroid.<b>` | the balance and face-floor checks hold with the implied reference | as in their base tests | `tests/CMakeLists.txt` |
| `configuration_check.py` `[C3]` (report check) | the spherical mean moments and pressure identities | exact symbolic or Boolean equality | the independent check |

: Source assertions, not new solver measurements. {#tbl-ch12-centroid-tests}

The thresholds are `TOL_ON` and `TOL_OFF` ({{< code tests/test_x1_centroid_rest.py TOL_ON >}},
{{< code tests/test_x1_centroid_rest.py TOL_OFF >}}) applied in `main`
({{< code tests/test_x1_centroid_rest.py main >}}); the seam assertion is
{{< code tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp X1SeamSplit.centroid_exact_split_matches_one_block >}}; the switched arms
are registered in {{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}.

No snapy runtime test is executed for this chapter. CUDA and multi-rank entries describe registration only.
The independent checks and their outputs are catalogued in @sec-ch15-ch12-tests.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
XC provides no gnomonic measure conversion. XC together with face work, RE or FC has no registered numerical
evidence. On a Cartesian grid the switch still changes the reference through WB; it is not a no-op there.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
